CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION editorial_security.maintenance_caller()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('role', true), 'none'), session_user::text)
    IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role', 'supabase_auth_admin')
$function$
functions.name: maintenance_caller

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_last_admin_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- A contagem será protegida pelo trigger AFTER na mesma transação.
  IF NOT editorial_security.maintenance_caller() AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=auth.uid() AND is_active AND access_level='admin'
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exclusão de perfil requer administrador ativo.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN OLD;
END $function$
functions.name: protect_last_admin_delete

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION editorial_security.serialize_profiles()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE editorial_security.admin_state SET revision=revision+1 WHERE singleton;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estado administrativo ausente.'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$
functions.name: serialize_profiles
protect_auth_delete

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION editorial_security.reject_truncate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRUNCATE bloqueado: preserve o administrador ativo.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END $function$
functions.name: reject_truncate

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_team_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid()
      AND is_active = TRUE
  );
$function$
functions.name: is_active_team_member

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid()
      AND access_level = 'admin'
      AND is_active = TRUE
  );
$function$
functions.name: is_active_admin
